messages:
pagerbot: ALERT asia2 - high GPU evictions + request 5xx spike (eviction-rate=12% last 5m). Nodes rebooting. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/asia2-gpu-evictions
eli: ACK. i'm on it - will start triage. paging SRE.
jen: looking at node logs now, seeing repeated 'NMI: Kernel panic' on nvidia driver right before evict. attaching snippet:
jen: ```
[kernel] NMI: GPU watchdog timeout on device 0
[evict] docker shim: oom_kill_process
```
amit: driver team reported a bad driver image rolled yesterday to image-gpu:v2.14. rolling back to v2.12 might help.
eli: good context. can we cordon and drain affected nodes to prevent further evictions? `kubectl cordon gpu-node-1 && kubectl drain gpu-node-1 --ignore-daemonsets`
ryan: we should avoid mass drain; will redirect traffic to eu-west using the smart-router. prepping traffic-shift plan: 20% -> 50% over 10m, canary then steady.
lina: cost note: if we shift long-term we'll hit higher cross-region egress. propose pre-warm reserved nodes in eu-west momentarily to avoid cold-start.
jen: quick check: autoscaler isn't triggering because capacity pool is full. we may need manual scale-up of asia2-gpu-pool + force-eviction-safety flags.
eli: i'm going to update pagerflow to include eviction-rate > 10% as an immediate page to SRE lead, not just pagebot warnings.
jen: +1. current pagebot threshold was latency>200ms; eviction based paging makes sense.
ryan: can we add a 5-min suppression window for pagers during planned rollbacks to avoid noise? e.g., after rollback starts, suppress repeats for 300s.
amit: rollback queued: `image-promote v2.12 -> asia2`. ETA 4m.
pagerbot: ACTIONLOG: rollback job started by amit. job id: 0x7a3f
eli: once rollback completes, we'll run 5-min health check: `kubectl get pods -n gpu | grep CrashLoop` and `curl /health` on model endpoints.
lina: ops will stand up 4 eu-west pre-warm nodes, tag them temporary, will monitor cost. ping me if we run >8h.
jen: noticed a networking blip between asia2 racks at 17:02 that correlates with evictions — filing infra-ticket INF-2314.
ryan: update to pagerflow: add runbook link and step to coordinate traffic-shift with platform. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/asia2-incident
eli: handoff plan: if incident unresolved in 30m, escalate to ENG-LEADS and schedule oncall rotation handoff. new paging policy draft: eviction threshold + rollback window + 5-min suppression during rollback.
jen: tests passing on rollback, memory pressure normalizing on rebooted nodes.
amit: rollback completed. monitoring for next 10m.
pagerbot: RESOLVE_CANDIDATE: eviction-rate dropped to 1.2% in last 5m. please confirm stable before closing.
eli: confirming — leaving thread open 15m then close if stable. thanks everyone :pray:
ryan: file follow-up: propose weekly stress test of driver upgrades in canary pool, and update upgrade playbook.
lina: i'll add cost estimate and alert to finance for extended eu-west shift.
eli: closing note: will update oncall runbook and PR to pagerbot config after incident.
